name: Carousel – Image Carousel, Post Slider, Product & Video Gallery
author: Themepoints

sections.description:
Carousel is a lightweight, responsive, and developer-friendly WordPress carousel plugin built to create high-converting image sliders, blog post carousels, video showcases, and WooCommerce product galleries.

Re-engineered from the ground up in version 2.0.0, Carousel utilizes modern PHP architecture to deliver maximum performance, optimized CSS/JS enqueuing, and zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS). Whether you are building a simple brand logo carousel, a portfolio showcase, or a dynamic blog post slider, Carousel gives you full control over layout, responsiveness, and autoplay settings without slowing down your website.

🚀 Key Free Features

  • Unlimited Images & Slides: Add as many slides, images, and captions as you need—no artificial limits on the free version.
  • Custom Image Carousel: Easily create image sliders with drag-and-drop ordering, custom links, and lightbox previews.
  • Dynamic Post Slider: Display recent posts, filter by categories, and toggle post titles, dates, authors, excerpts, and “Read More” buttons.
  • Video Carousel: Embed responsive YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted MP4 videos inside your sliders.
  • WooCommerce Product Carousel: Display featured, top-rated, on-sale, or category-specific products with live “Add to Cart” buttons.
  • Zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS): Pre-calculated aspect ratios keep your site layout stable during page loads.
  • Smart Asset Loading: Enqueues scripts and stylesheets only when a carousel or shortcode is actively present on the page.
  • Full Responsive Breakpoints: Custom controls for columns and spacing across Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile devices.
  • Page Builder Ready: Seamlessly works with Gutenberg blocks, Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and classic shortcodes.
  • Touch & Drag Enabled: Smooth touch-swipe navigation optimized for mobile devices and tablets.
  • Customizable Controls: Toggle autoplay, autoplay speed, hover pause, infinite loop, navigation arrows, pagination dots, and slide transition effects.

💎 Pro Features

Upgrade to Carousel Pro to unlock advanced layouts, multimedia support, and dynamic ecommerce integrations:
* Standard Grid & Masonry Layouts: Switch seamlessly between smooth sliders, structured grids, and fluid masonry layouts.
* Content Overlay Design Style: Display title, meta, and button content as modern hover overlays on top of images.
sections.installation:
1. Log into your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for Carousel.
  4. Click Install Now and activate the plugin.
  5. Navigate to Carousel > Add New in your sidebar to create your first slider!
  6. Copy the generated shortcode and paste it into any post, page, widget, or page builder element.
sections.faq:
Is Carousel responsive?

Yes! You can specify exact column counts and spacing for Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile devices individually.

Can I use Carousel with Elementor or Gutenberg?

Absolutely. Carousel provides shortcode compatibility across all major page builders, as well as native integration components.

Does the free version limit how many images I can upload?

No. The free version allows unlimited images, slides, and post sliders.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

You can upgrade directly from your WordPress admin dashboard under Carousel > Account or via our official website.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0 – September 30, 2026

  • Major Release: Complete codebase rewrite using modern PHP OOP architecture.
  • Performance: Introduced conditional frontend asset loading (scripts load only when shortcode/block is present).
  • UX Fix: Added CSS aspect-ratio placeholders to eliminate Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
  • Feature: Refactored metabox settings UI with visual option selectors.
  • Feature: Added Video, WooCommerce Products, Grid, and Overlay layouts.
  • Fix: Resolved jQuery dependency conflicts and improved script initialization on dynamic page loads.
  • Security: Hardened shortcode output sanitization and metabox nonce validation.
